name: StrengthAnalysis.T.RectStressBlock
comment: Returns the ultimate moment and axial force of a polygon section under a rectangular stress block. Arguments: sectionCoor, fcd, εcu, Ec, rebarAreaArr, rebarDepthArr, fyd, Es, λ, neutralAxisDepth, isSaggingCapacity. sectionCoor is an n×2 array, x then y, with y upward and no repeated closing vertex. Units match StrengthAnalysis.RectSection.RectStressBlock. Depths are from the top. Hogging rotates the section 180 degrees and returns a negative moment. The compression block is the part of the section from the top down to λ times the neutral-axis depth. Steel stress is Es times strain, limited to ±fyd. Moment is about the transformed centroid, in kNm. Axial force is in kN, compression positive. The result is a 1×2 row, moment then axial. A neutral-axis depth of 0 returns #DIV/0!. Text or a polygon with fewer than two columns returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
